description: Runs a fixture-backed Web platform semantics probe for Registered custom property inheritance: inherits:true flows to a child while inherits:false falls back to initialValue. The scripted CDP driver observes page output from the self-hosted fixture `/v2/wpt_b/css_property_inherits`, and the server-side grader compares it with the Chrome-baked expected answer.
title: registered property inherits:true vs false
